name: Sage X3
description_en:
Sage X3 is Sage’s ERP for product-centric finance, supply chain and manufacturing. The current official US page uses Sage X3, while this catalog retains its existing Sage Business Cloud X3 slug. Other Sage products in the shared navigation are separate offers.

This profile examines production traceability and financial controls using the current X3 capability pages. It did not run a tenant, production order, AI invoice or statutory report. Pricing is left unknown because the pages read provide a request-pricing route without a numeric quote.
description_zh:
Sage X3 是 Sage 面向以产品为中心的财务、供应链和制造 ERP。当前美国官方页使用 Sage X3，本目录保留既有 Sage Business Cloud X3 slug，共享导航中的其他 Sage 产品属于不同方案。

本文依据当前 X3 能力页研究生产追溯及财务控制，未运行租户、生产订单、AI 发票或法定报表。已读页提供询价入口但没有数字报价，因此价格保持未知。

sections.title_en: Inspect the released BOM and accepted output
sections.title_zh: 检查释放的物料版本和合格产出
sections.en:
The production page describes commercial/production/subcontract BOMs, major/minor versions, operation reporting and batch/serial tracking with quality stock states. For a hypothetical batch, follow the selected version, component consumption, accepted/rejected output and finished-stock availability.

Then introduce a failed inspection or changed specification. Check how the selected configuration prevents unsuitable stock reaching dispatch. These are suggested tests, not proof of a blocking policy or regulatory validation. The page itself recommends confirming a formal MRP workflow with the Sage partner because configuration can vary.
sections.zh:
生产页介绍商业、生产及外协 BOM、主次版本、工序报工，以及带质检状态的批次序列号。可用一个假设批次追踪所选版本、组件消耗、合格不合格产出及成品可用量。

再加入检验失败或规格变化，检查所选配置如何防止不适合库存发运。这是建议测试，不是阻止政策或监管验证证明。页面本身建议与 Sage 伙伴确认正式 MRP 流程，因为配置可能不同。

sections.title_en: Carry operational detail into financial review
sections.title_zh: 把业务明细带入财务复核
sections.en:
The finance page describes general ledger/multiple charts, payables/receivables, cash/bank, analytical cost accounting, budgets and fixed assets. It also describes AI invoice extraction producing drafts for review and identifying potential duplicates.

Evaluate one supplier invoice against its receipt and accounting, including a duplicate and a wrong master-data value. Inspect who can approve the draft and how a correction reaches the reports. No extraction accuracy or automated authorization was tested. Multi-company/currency and legal-report labels do not establish every country’s tax coverage.
sections.zh:
财务页介绍总账多科目表、应收应付、现金银行、分析成本、预算及固定资产，也描述 AI 发票提取形成待复核草稿并识别潜在重复。

可用供应商发票对照收货及会计，加入重复和错误基础资料，检查谁批准草稿以及更正如何进入报表。本文未测试提取准确性或自动授权；多公司币种和法定报表标签不证明每个国家税务覆盖。

sections.title_en: Core capabilities and partner additions need a scope
sections.title_zh: 核心能力和伙伴扩展需明确范围
sections.en:
The production page separately lists marketplace/partner additions such as Procession, analytics and CADLink. Do not treat every linked extension as an included X3 module, license or regulatory solution. The current pages describe a cloud platform, but the exact hosting, supported version and maintenance arrangement need a proposal.

Prepare item/lot/serial rules, BOM versions, calendars, opening stock/WIP and financial balances. Test one full order-to-production-to-finance cycle and a rejected transaction in the actual selected modules. This research did not execute integrations, migration, access controls or a restore.
sections.zh:
生产页另列 Procession、分析工具和 CADLink 等市场伙伴扩展，不能把所有链接都当成已包含的 X3 模块、许可或监管方案。当前页描述云平台，但确切托管、支持版本和维护安排需要方案。

应准备物品批次序列号规则、BOM 版本、日历、期初库存在制及财务余额，并在实际所选模块中测试完整订单生产财务周期和拒绝交易。本文未执行集成、迁移、权限或恢复。

sections.title_zh: 取得针对 X3 的商业方案
sections.en:
The official X3 overview read on 22 October 2026 links Request pricing. The pages obtained did not establish a numeric rate, currency, user minimum or permanent free production edition. Ask for the chosen X3 modules, entities, users, hosting, extensions, AI use, implementation, training and support; these are scope questions rather than confirmed extra fees.

X3 is worth investigating for product-heavy manufacturing/distribution where those connected controls justify implementation. A generic invoice task may not. Contracted license rights, local reporting, data exports/retention and recovery remain unverified. Vendor automation percentages, customer quotes and country-count claims were not used as guaranteed outcomes.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的官方 X3 概览链接至 Request pricing，已获得页面未确立数字费率、币种、最低用户或永久免费生产版。应询问 X3 模块、实体用户、托管扩展、AI 用量、实施培训和支持；这些是范围问题，不是已确认加价。

如果以产品为核心的制造分销需要这些关联控制，可以调查 X3，普通开票任务可能无需如此。合同许可、当地报表、导出保留及恢复未核实；本文未把自动化百分比、客户引语和国家数当保证效果。
